title: Technical SEO: Prevent Google Invisibility Caused by Shadow DOM
body:
¿Have you integrated new interactive components on your website and suddenly your organic traffic has plummeted?

Many B2B companies and online stores modernize their platforms using custom elements without knowing they are burying their high-intent commercial keywords under a technical layer impenetrable to search engines, losing thousands of dollars in sales every week.

The Trap of Encapsulated Web Components

The common mistake is blindly trusting that Googlebot renders absolutely all modern JavaScript. By encapsulating catalogs, pricing tables, or review blocks in an independent DOM tree, the crawler hits a wall that renders transactional text invisible. What your client sees seamlessly, Google completely ignores.

Our Solution: Transparent Shadow DOM Indexing

At LANZAESTUDIO we analyze the root structure of your interactive components and reconfigure rendering to ensure absolute indexing of your premium content.

  1. Deep audit of the hidden DOM tree: We precisely identify which semantic fragments are being left out of the search engines’ main rendering process.
  2. Open Shadow DOM Implementation: We modify encapsulation to allow direct crawler access without breaking design modularity.
  3. Hybrid Server-Side Rendering (SSR) Enabling: We inject critical content directly into the initial HTML to guarantee speed and visibility.
  4. Real-time crawl testing: We validate using reverse engineering tools that Google’s robot assimilates each transactional keyword.

The Real Impact on Your Organic Conversion

  • Total positioning recovery: You will reappear in the top results for your most lucrative business terms.
  • Direct increase in commercial CTR: Google will display correct rich snippets by being able to read the internal structured data.
  • Savings in paid acquisition costs: The recovered organic traffic will replace the reliance on expensive ad campaigns.
